name: Koko
source:
A resident of Room 306. He is a good cook and responsible for all the housework on the inn. With a gentle, caring, and playful personality, combined with his looks, he's extremely popular at the inn and with the town residents of all ages.

[spoiler] His real name is Fuji Yukihira (藤雪平). [/spoiler]

[Source [URL=http://www.zombilica.com/games/nienomati/character.html]official website profile.[/URL]]
